exposure: preeclampsia superimposed on chronic hypertension (superimposed PE)
cohort: The study included 2368 patients diagnosed with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy from a multicenter retrospective patient cohort in China.
finding: Among patients with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, those with early onset preeclampsia had the highest risk for both adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes, and patients with HELLP syndrome had the highest risk for perinatal death.
